examName: Implementing End-to-End Security Controls for Cloud and AI Workloads
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for SC-500. Unlike the GA exams, this study guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — SC-500 is in beta and Microsoft is publishing a single undated skills list. Re-check learn.microsoft.com before the exam, and expect this outline to be dated once the exam reaches general availability.

domains.name: Manage identity, access, and governance
subtopics: Implement and configure Privileged Identity Management and Conditional Access policies
Implement authentication methods including multifactor authentication and passwordless
Configure identity for applications, including enterprise applications and app registrations
Manage OAuth permission grants and consent settings
Implement and configure managed identities for Azure resources
Deploy Azure Key Vault and configure its settings, access, and firewall
Manage keys, secrets, and certificates, and implement Defender for Key Vault
Scan for secrets by using Defender Cloud Security Posture Management
Implement security controls with Azure Policy, resource locks, and infrastructure as code
Manage built-in and custom role assignments and remediate overprivileged access with Azure RBAC

domains.name: Secure storage, databases, and networking
subtopics: Implement and configure security for storage accounts, including firewall rules and access policies
Implement Defender for Storage threat protection configurations
Implement platform-level security configurations in Azure SQL and configure database auditing
Configure Defender for Databases protection across Azure database services
Implement and manage network security groups and application security groups
Configure network access policies by using Azure Virtual Network Manager
Configure security for an Azure Virtual WAN and for VPN connections
Implement and configure Microsoft Entra Private Access
Configure Azure private endpoints and Private Link services to secure access to resources
Implement and configure Azure Firewall and evaluate effective rules with Network Watcher

domains.name: Secure compute
subtopics: Identify overexposure of data in SharePoint and AI risks by using Purview DSPM
Configure real-time protection for Copilot Studio agents and Conditional Access for Entra Agent ID
Analyse blast radius for Entra Agent ID risks by using Defender XDR and manage agent access
Configure AI Gateway in Azure API Management and guardrails for agent security in Foundry
Enable Defender for AI Service and monitor the Data and AI security dashboard
Implement disk encryption, Azure Bastion, and just-in-time VM access
Extend security controls to hybrid and multicloud servers by using Azure Arc
Onboard servers to Defender for Servers and configure vulnerability scanning and EDR
Configure VM security features including secure boot, vTPM, and integrity monitoring
Implement security controls for containers, AKS, Container Registry, Functions, Logic Apps, App Service, and API Management

domains.name: Manage and monitor security posture
subtopics: Identify security risks by using Defender CSPM and evaluate compliance against frameworks
Enable and configure Defender for Cloud workload protection plans
Connect hybrid cloud and multicloud environments including AWS and GCP to Defender for Cloud
Configure Defender Vulnerability Management settings and discover assets with Defender EASM
Create and connect Microsoft Sentinel workspaces and assign roles
Implement content hub solutions and configure Microsoft data connectors
Implement syslog, CEF, and Windows Security event collection with data collection rules
Create custom log tables and implement data retention in Microsoft Sentinel data stores
Implement automation rules and playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel
Configure workspaces, permissions, plugins, and agents for Microsoft Security Copilot
